summary: Luckin Coffee, a foreign private issuer filing a Form 6-K (the US-equivalent disclosure vehicle for non-US issuers), furnished its Q3 2026 earnings release and announced that its board approved a new share repurchase program of up to US$500 million. No price per share, premium, start or expiry date, or authorization period is disclosed. Q3 net revenues were RMB17.9 billion (+17.0% y/y), GAAP operating income RMB2.76 billion (15.4% margin), and average monthly transacting customers hit a record 123.0 million. What to watch: buyback execution pace against negative 11.1% same-store sales and the OTC-listed share base.
